page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred. Top: title in large capitals over three lines, then subtitle in small capitals, then author line in spaced capitals. Centre: woodcut device (anchor within an oval cartouche) with motto. Below: imprint in italic and roman, centred. Page number "2" in the upper right corner, handwritten, not printed.
page.notes: The woodcut device shows an anchor with a cross-bar, entwined with foliage, inside an oval cartouche; the motto around it reads "·ANCHORA·SPEI·" (partly obscured by the anchor, with "AN" on the left and "SPEI" on the right, "CHO" and "RA" visible). Handwritten marks at the left edge and a pen stroke at the right are not printed text. The "2" at the upper right is a manuscript foliation, not a printed page number.
